Settings.title: Attendance Settings
Settings.subtitle: Configure global time windows that apply to all employees. Changes take effect immediately on the next check-in or check-out.
Settings.earlyCheckinDesc: How many minutes before the shift starts can an employee clock in.
Settings.lateGraceDesc: Minutes after shift start before an employee is marked as late.
Settings.checkoutWindowDesc: Minutes after shift end that employees are allowed to clock out.
Settings.maxOvertimeDesc: Maximum overtime minutes recorded per shift. Also extends the check-out window for overtime-enabled employees.
Settings.howItWorksBody: These settings apply globally to all employees. Early Check-in controls when the check-in button becomes available. Late Grace gives employees a buffer before being marked late. Check-out Window limits how long after shift end employees can clock out. Max Overtime caps the overtime minutes recorded and extends the check-out window for overtime-enabled employees.
